-- Coriolanus
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Coriolanus, Shakespeare, New Swan Theatre, minimalist, unit set'
WHERE slug = 'coriolanus';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'coriolanus'
AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', 'Minimalist', 'Unit Set', 'Theatre Festival', '2022', 'Tragedy');
